payload.comment: All primary abstention metrics are internally consistent: test_coverage (0.774095) + abstain_rate (0.225905) = 1.0; selective_risk (0.11353) = 1 − accuracy_on_covered (0.88647); human_review_count (1622) ≈ 7180 × 0.225905; validation_coverage (0.80008) meets the 0.8 target. No deterministic findings are present. The ood_auroc of 0.25401 is below the 0.5 chance level, which is a legitimate concern; however, it is explicitly scoped as a 'controlled_corruption_proxy' using max_softmax (a known-weak confidence signal) under mild σ=0.25 Gaussian noise.
